atoms.text:
Allie and Arnold are best friends. They are also next door neighbours. Sometimes they get into trouble. Allie likes to explore. Arnold is a bit shy. One day, Allie asked Arnold to go to the playground across the road.

Arnold did not want to go. His parents don’t let him cross the road without an adult. Allie begged Arnold to go to the playground anyways.

“I don’t want to go,” says Arnold. “I want to play at our playground.”

Allie says, “But we play there all the time. I want to explore! We could be pirates looking for new land!”

Arnold says, “We can do that here too. My parents would be mad if I crossed the road alone.”

Arnold pretended he was a pirate and chased Allie. They had a fun afternoon and Arnold was happy he didn’t break the rules.
